author: VOfficial404

description.en: Node-based image generation, at 127.0.0.1:8188. Colab may end free-tier runtimes that run image-generation UIs: a paid plan is safer.
description.zh-Hans: 节点式图像生成，映射到 127.0.0.1:8188。Colab 可能终止运行图像生成界面的免费运行时，建议使用付费方案。
description.zh-Hant: 節點式影像生成，對應到 127.0.0.1:8188。Colab 可能終止執行影像生成介面的免費執行階段，建議使用付費方案。

help.en: A .safetensors to download into models/checkpoints; leave empty to add models yourself.
help.zh-Hans: 下载到 models/checkpoints 的 .safetensors；留空则自行添加模型。
help.zh-Hant: 下載到 models/checkpoints 的 .safetensors；留空則自行加入模型。

script:
# ComfyUI on the runtime, at 127.0.0.1:8188. Fields arrive as COLAUNCH_<KEY>.
set -euo pipefail
# Installing and downloading serve nothing: keep the idle watchdog away.
( while true; do touch "$COLAUNCH_BUSY"; sleep 30; done ) &
BUSY=$!
trap 'kill "$BUSY" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

echo "@@PHASE install@@"
if [ ! -d ComfyUI/.git ]; then
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI.git
fi
# Colab's Python already has PyTorch for its GPU, which requirements.txt keeps.
python3 -m pip install -q -r ComfyUI/requirements.txt

if [ -n "${COLAUNCH_CHECKPOINT:-}" ]; then
  echo "@@PHASE download@@"
  mkdir -p ComfyUI/models/checkpoints
  name=$(basename "${COLAUNCH_CHECKPOINT%%\?*}")
  case "$name" in
    *.safetensors|*.ckpt|*.pt|*.pth|*.bin) ;;
    *) name=checkpoint.safetensors ;;
  esac
  dest="ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/$name"
  if [ ! -s "$dest" ]; then
    wget -q --show-progress --progress=bar:force:noscroll -O "$dest.part" "$COLAUNCH_CHECKPOINT"
    mv "$dest.part" "$dest"
  fi
fi

kill "$BUSY" 2>/dev/null || true
trap - EXIT
args=(--listen 127.0.0.1 --port 8188 --preview-method "${COLAUNCH_PREVIEW:-auto}")
if [ "${COLAUNCH_LOWVRAM:-false}" = true ]; then
  args+=(--lowvram)
fi
cd ComfyUI
echo "@@PHASE start@@"
exec python3 main.py "${args[@]}"
readme:
# ComfyUI

Clones [ComfyUI](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI) on the runtime, installs its requirements with pip, optionally downloads one checkpoint, and serves it on 127.0.0.1:8188, forwarded to the same port here.

**Free tier:** Colab's free tier may end runtimes that run image-generation interfaces, and forbids generating deepfakes. Use a paid plan, and follow Colab's rules: https://research.google.com/colaboratory/faq.html#disallowed-activities
